audit_title: Air-Gapped Offline Execution & Zero Cloud Egress Verification

verification_mechanisms.evidence: ZERO_CLOUD_EGRESS = True constant enforced across all endpoint schemas and startup validation.
Weights loaded strictly from local disk paths (models/Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct and models/c3_lora_final). Zero HuggingFace Hub network calls at runtime.
Uvicorn server binds strictly to 127.0.0.1:8003. Network disconnect test executed with active Wi-Fi disabled; inference latency and predictions identical.
Local inference applies 100% offline to edge testing deployment. Training data synthesis utilized cloud teacher labels during the offline data generation phase, as documented in manifests.
